Summary: Your PC is crashing due to a graphics driver issue, specifically linked to the NVIDIA driver update from Tuesday.
likely_cause: A recent NVIDIA graphics driver update caused instability, leading to blue screens and driver resets.
Evidence: On Sat 3:29:24 AM, a blue screen occurred with error code 0x116 linked to nvlddmkm.sys, the NVIDIA driver.
An NVIDIA driver update (nvlddmkm 32.0.15.6094) was installed on Tuesday at 9:09 PM, just before the crashes began.
Graphics driver resets occurred on Friday and Saturday, matching the timeline of the update.
No other crashes, memory issues, or network problems were recorded during this period.
Steps: Uninstall the latest NVIDIA graphics driver from Device Manager or through the NVIDIA control panel.
Restart your PC after uninstalling the driver.
Download and install the latest stable version of the NVIDIA driver from the official website.
Check if the blue screens return after the update.
